10. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-4,3)\) and \((6,5)\) respectively. Let \(G\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(A G=B G\). Denote the locus of \(G\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(A B\).
(b) If \(A B\) is a chord of the circle \(x^{2}+y^{2}-2 a x+4 a y-85=0\), where \(a\) is a constant, find the value of \(a\).
before.stemZh:
10. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((-4,3)\) 和 \((6,5)\)。動點 \(G\) 在直角坐標平面上移動，並滿足 \(AG=BG\)。以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(G\) 的軌跡。
(a) (i) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(ii) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與線段 \(AB\) 的幾何關係。
(b) 若 \(AB\) 為圓 \(x^2+y^2-2ax+4ay-85=0\) 的弦，其中 \(a\) 為常數，求 \(a\) 的值。
before.hint: AG=BG means G is equidistant from A and B — write the distance formula, square both sides, and simplify. For (b), remember the perpendicular bisector of a chord always passes through the circle centre.
before.hintZh: AG=BG 即 G 到 A、B 等距——寫距離公式，兩邊平方化簡。(b) 記住弦的垂直平分線必過圓心。
before.solution:
10. (a)(i) Let \((x, y)\) be the coordinates of \(G\).

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \because \quad A G=B G \\
& \quad \begin{aligned}
\sqrt{[x-(-4)]^{2}+(y-3)^{2}} & =\sqrt{(x-6)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}} \\
\therefore \quad x^{2}+8 x+16+y^{2}-6 y+9 & =x^{2}-12 x+36+y^{2}-10 y+25 \\
20 x+4 y-36 & =0 \\
5 x+y-9 & =0
\end{aligned}
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus, the equation of \(\Gamma\) is \(5 x+y-9=0\).
(ii) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment \(A B\).
(b) Note that perpendicular bisector \(\Gamma\) of chord \(A B\) passes through the centre of the circle.

The coordinates of the centre of the circle are \((a,-2 a)\).

By (a), we have \(5 a-2 a-9=0\).

So, we have \(a=3\).
before.solutionZh:
10. (a)(i) 設 \(G=(x,y)\) 為所求動點。

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \because \quad AG=BG \\
& \sqrt{[x-(-4)]^{2}+(y-3)^{2}}=\sqrt{(x-6)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}} \\
& \therefore \quad x^{2}+8x+16+y^{2}-6y+9=x^{2}-12x+36+y^{2}-10y+25 \\
& 20x+4y-36=0 \\
& 5x+y-9=0
\end{aligned}
\]

所以 Γ 的方程為 \(5x+y−9=0\)。

(a)(ii) Γ 是線段 AB 的垂直平分線。

(b) 弦 AB 的垂直平分線必經過圓心。

圓心坐標為 (a,−2a)。

由 (a) 得 \(5a−2a−9=0\)。

所以 \(a=3\)。

12. \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the distance between \(P\) and the line \(L: y=-3\) is always equal to the distance from \(P\) to a fixed point \(C(2,-1)\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Describe the locus of p .
(b) Find the equation of a circle with centre \(C\) which touches \(\Gamma\).
before.stemZh:
12. 動點 \(P\) 與直線 \(L:y=-3\) 的距離，恆等於 \(P\) 與固定點 \(C=(2,-1)\) 的距離，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(a) (i) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程；(ii) 描述 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(b) 求一個以 \(C\) 為圓心且與 \(\Gamma\) 相切的圓的方程。
before.hint: Distance from P to line y=-3 is |y+3|. Set it equal to sqrt((x-2)²+(y+1)²) and square. The result is a parabola — find its vertex for (b).
before.hintZh: P 到 y=-3 的距離是 |y+3|，等於 sqrt((x-2)²+(y+1)²)，平方後是拋物線。(b) 找頂點。
before.solution:
12. \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the distance between \(P\) and the line \(L: y=-3\) is always equal to the distance from \(P\) to a fixed point \(C(2,-1)\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Describe the locus of \(P\).
(b) Find the equation of a circle with centre \(C\) which touches \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Let \(P(x, y)\).

Equation of \(\Gamma\) :

\[
\begin{aligned}
y^{2}+6 y+9 & =x^{2}-4 x+4+y^{2}+2 y+1 \\
4 y & =x^{2}-4 x-4 \\
y & =\frac{1}{4} x^{2}-x-1
\end{aligned}
\]

□  
(a) (ii) The locus of \(P\) is a parabola/quadratic curve. \(\quad 1 \mathrm{~A}\)
(b) \(\because\) the radius of the required circle \(=\) vertical distance from \(C\) to the vertex of \(\Gamma\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{1}{2} \times \text { shortest distance from } C \text { to } L \\
& =\frac{1}{2}(-1-(-3)) \\
& =1
\end{aligned}
\]

∴ Equation of the required circle:

\[
\begin{array}{r}
(x-2)^{2}+(y-(-1))^{2}=1^{2} \\
(x-2)^{2}+(y+1)^{2}=1
\end{array}
\]
before.solutionZh:
12. P 到直線 \(L:y=−3\) 的距離等於 P 到定點 C(2,−1) 的距離。

(a)(i) 設 P(x,y)。Γ 的方程：

\[
\begin{aligned}
y^{2}+6y+9&=x^{2}-4x+4+y^{2}+2y+1 \\
4y&=x^{2}-4x-4 \\
y&=\frac14 x^{2}-x-1
\end{aligned}
\]

(a)(ii) P 的軌跡是一條拋物線。

(b) 所求圓半徑 \(=\) C 到 Γ 頂點的垂直距離 \(=\) \((1/2)×C\) 到 L 的最短距離：

\[
=\frac12(-1-(-3))=1
\]

所求圓方程：

\[
(x-2)^{2}+(y+1)^{2}=1
\]

12. The coordinates of the points A and B are (–14 , 0) and (34 , 0) respectively. The circle C passes through A 
and B . The radius of C is 30 . Denote the centre of C by G and G lies in Quadrant I . 
 (a) Find the equation of C . (3 marks) 
 (b) P is a moving point in the rectangular plane such that AP = GP . Denote the locus of P by Γ . 
 (i) Describe the geometric relationship between Γ and AG . 
(ii) If Γ cuts C at Q and R , Mr. Cheng claims that the area of the quadrilateral QARG is less than 
780 . Do you agree? Explain your answer. 
(4 marks)
before.stemZh:
12. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((-14,0)\) 和 \((34,0)\)。圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A\)、\(B\)，半徑為 \(30\)；圓心 \(G\) 位於第一象限。
(a) 求圓 \(C\) 的方程。
(b) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=GP\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AG\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 若 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(Q,R\)，有人聲稱四邊形 \(QARG\) 的面積小於 \(780\)。你是否同意？解釋答案。
before.hint: GA=GB means G is on the perpendicular bisector of AB. Since A,B are on x-axis, that bisector is x=10. Then use radius 30 to find k.
before.hintZh: GA=GB 即 G 在 AB 垂直平分線上。A、B 在 x 軸，平分線是 x=10，再用半徑 30 求 k。
before.solution:
(a) Since \(GA=GB\), \(G\) lies on the perpendicular bisector \(x=10\). Put \(G=(10,k)\). From \(GA=30\),

\[
24^2+k^2=30^2,\qquad k=\pm18.
\]

As \(G\) lies in quadrant I, \(G=(10,18)\). Hence

\[
C:(x-10)^2+(y-18)^2=900.
\]

(b)(i) Since \(AP=GP\), \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(AG\).
(ii) At the intersections, \(QA=QG=RA=RG=30\), so \(QARG\) is a rhombus. Let \(M=\Gamma\cap AG\). Then \(AG=30\) and \(MG=15\). In right triangle \(GMQ\),

\[
MQ=\sqrt{30^2-15^2}=15\sqrt3,\qquad QR=30\sqrt3.
\]

The diagonals are perpendicular, so

\[
[QARG]=\frac12(AG)(QR)=450\sqrt3\approx779.42<780.
\]

Therefore the claim is correct.
before.solutionZh:
(a) \(GA=GB\)，所以 G 在 AB 的垂直平分線 \(x=10\) 上。設 \(G=(10,k)\)。由 \(GA=30\)：

\[
24^2+k^2=30^2,\qquad k=\pm18
\]

G 在第一象限，\(G=(10,18)\)。所以

\[
C:(x-10)^2+(y-18)^2=900
\]

(b)(i) \(AP=GP\)，Γ 是 AG 的垂直平分線。

(b)(ii) 交點處 \(QA=QG=RA=RG=30\)，所以 QARG 是菱形。設 \(M=Γ∩AG\)，\(AG=30\)，\(MG=15\)。在直角三角形 GMQ 中：

\[
MQ=\sqrt{30^2-15^2}=15\sqrt3,\qquad QR=30\sqrt3
\]

對角線互相垂直：

\[
[QARG]=\frac12(AG)(QR)=450\sqrt3\approx779.42<780
\]

13. The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2+kx-32y+256=0,
\]where \(k\) is a constant. Let \(G\) be the centre of \(C\). \(A\) is a point lying on the \(y\)-axis and the equation of the straight line passing through \(A\) and \(G\) is
\[
3x+4y-28=0.
\](a) Find \(k\). (2 marks)
(b) Does \(A\) lie outside \(C\)? Explain your answer. (2 marks)
(c) Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(AP=GP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). Suppose \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at the points \(M\) and \(N\). Is the area of \(\triangle GMN\) less than \(68\) square units? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
before.stemZh:
13. 圓 \(C\) 的方程為 \(x^2+y^2+kx-32y+256=0\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。以 \(G\) 表示圓心。點 \(A\) 位於 \(y\) 軸上，直線 \(AG\) 的方程為 \(3x+4y-28=0\)。
(a) 求 \(k\)。（2 分）
(b) \(A\) 是否位於圓 \(C\) 外？解釋答案。（2 分）
(c) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=GP\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。若 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(M,N\)，\(\triangle GMN\) 的面積是否小於 \(68\) 平方單位？解釋答案。（3 分）
before.hint: Centre is (-k/2, 16). Substitute into the line 3x+4y-28=0. For (b), find A at x=0 and compare AG with radius.
before.hintZh: 圓心 (-k/2, 16) 代入 3x+4y-28=0。(b) 令 x=0 找 A，比較 AG 同半徑。
before.solution:
(a) The centre is \(G=(-\frac{k}{2},16)\). Substitution into \(AG\) gives

\[
3(-\tfrac{k}{2})+4(16)-28=0,
\]

so \(k=24\). Thus \(G=(-12,16)\) and the radius is \(12\).

(b) Setting \(x=0\) gives \(A=(0,7)\). Since \(AG=\sqrt{12^2+9^2}=15>12\), \(A\) is outside \(C\).

(c) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(AG\). Let \(Q=AG\cap\Gamma\), so \(GQ=\frac{15}{2}\). The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord:

\[
MQ=\sqrt{12^2-(\tfrac{15}{2})^2}=\tfrac{\sqrt{351}}2,\qquad MN=\sqrt{351}.
\]

The triangle height is \(GQ\), not \(AG\). Hence

\[
[GMN]=\tfrac12\sqrt{351}\cdot\tfrac{15}{2}=\tfrac{45\sqrt{39}}4\approx70.26>68.
\]

The area is not less than \(68\) square units.

14. The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2+mx+ny-560=0,
\]where \(m\) and \(n\) are constants. Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). The straight line \(L\) cuts \(C\) at the points \(R\) and \(S\). Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(RP=SP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). It is given that the coordinates of \(R\) are \((12,44)\) and the equation of \(\Gamma\) is
\[
x-3y+30=0.
\](a) Find \(m\) and \(n\).
(b) Find the equation of \(L\).
(c) \(T\) is a point lying on \(C\) such that \(RT=RS\). Someone claims that the area of \(\triangle RST\) exceeds \(980\) square units. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
before.stemZh:
14. 圓 \(C\) 的方程為 \(x^2+y^2+mx+ny-560=0\)，其中 \(m,n\) 為常數，以 \(G\) 表示圓心。直線 \(L\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(R,S\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(RP=SP\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示其軌跡。已知 \(R=(12,44)\)，\(\Gamma\) 的方程為 \(x-3y+30=0\)。
(a) 求 \(m,n\)。
(b) 求 \(L\) 的方程。
(c) 點 \(T\) 位於 \(C\) 上，並滿足 \(RT=RS\)。有人聲稱 \(\triangle RST\) 的面積大於 \(980\) 平方單位。你是否同意？解釋答案。（8 分）
before.hint: R is on the circle → substitute. RP=SP locus is perpendicular bisector of RS, which passes through centre G. Solve two equations for m,n.
before.hintZh: R 在圓上代入。RP=SP 的軌跡是 RS 垂直平分線，過圓心 G。兩方程解 m,n。
before.solution:
(a) Substituting \(R=(12,44)\) gives \(3m+11n=-380\). The perpendicular bisector \(\Gamma\) passes through \(G=(-\frac m2,-\frac n2)\), giving \(m-3n=60\). Thus \(m=-24\), \(n=-28\) and \(G=(12,14)\).

(b) Since \(L\perp\Gamma\), its slope is \(-3\). Through \(R\), \(y-44=-3(x-12)\), or \(3x+y-80=0\).

(c) The intersection of \(L\) and \(\Gamma\) is the chord midpoint \(H=(21,17)\), so \(S=2H-R=(30,-10)\). Reflection in \(RG:x=12\) gives the other point \(T=(-6,-10)\) with \(RT=RS\). Hence \(ST=36\) and the height from \(R\) is \(54\):

\[
[RST]=\tfrac12(36)(54)=972<980.
\]

The claim is false. If \(T=S\), the area is \(0\) and the claim remains false.

13. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((5,10)\) and \((-1,2)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(BP=AB\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) It is given that the coordinates of the point \(H\) are \((-11,2)\).
(i) Does \(\Gamma\) pass through \(H\)? Explain your answer.
(ii) Find the distance between \(A\) and \(H\).
(iii) \(K\) is a point lying on \(\Gamma\). Someone claims that the area of \(\triangle AHK\) cannot exceed \(150\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
before.hint: BP=AB is a circle centred at B. Max triangle area when K is farthest from line AH — add centre-to-line distance to radius.
before.hintZh: BP=AB 是以 B 為心的圓。面積最大當 K 離 AH 最遠——中心到線距離加半徑。
before.solution:
13.

(a) Since \(BP=AB\), the locus \(\Gamma\) is the circle with centre \(B(-1,2)\) and radius \(AB\).

Now

\[
AB^2=(5-(-1))^2+(10-2)^2=6^2+8^2=100.
\]

Therefore,

\[
(x+1)^2+(y-2)^2=100.
\]

(b)(i) For \(H(-11,2)\),

\[
(-11+1)^2+(2-2)^2=100.
\]

Therefore, \(\Gamma\) passes through \(H\).

(b)(ii)

\[
AH=\sqrt{(-11-5)^2+(2-10)^2}
=\sqrt{320}
=8\sqrt5.
\]

(b)(iii) The maximum area of \(\triangle AHK\) occurs when the perpendicular distance from \(K\) to \(AH\) is greatest.

The line \(AH\) has equation

\[
x-2y+15=0.
\]

The perpendicular distance from the centre \(B(-1,2)\) to \(AH\) is

\[
\frac{|(-1)-2(2)+15|}{\sqrt{1^2+(-2)^2}}
=\frac{10}{\sqrt5}
=2\sqrt5.
\]

Since the radius of \(\Gamma\) is \(10\), the greatest perpendicular distance from \(K\) to \(AH\) is

\[
10+2\sqrt5.
\]

Hence the maximum area is

\[
\frac12(8\sqrt5)(10+2\sqrt5)
=40\sqrt5+40
\approx 129.4<150.
\]

Therefore, the claim is correct.

13. The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2-18x+ky=0,
\]where \(k\) is a positive constant. Suppose \(C\) cuts the positive \(x\)-axis and the negative \(y\)-axis at points \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. Denote the origin by \(O\). Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(AP=AO\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\). (3 marks)
(b) It is given that \(C\) and \(\Gamma\) intersect at \(O\) and the point \(G\), where
\[
5AG=3AB.
\](i) Find the value of \(k\).
(ii) Find the area of the quadrilateral \(OAGB\). (4 marks)
before.stemZh:
13. 圓 \(C:x^2+y^2-18x+ky=0\)，\(k>0\)，分別與正 \(x\) 軸、負 \(y\) 軸交於 \(A,B\)。原點為 \(O\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=AO\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。（3 分）
(b) \(C\) 與 \(\Gamma\) 交於 \(O,G\)，且 \(5AG=3AB\)。
(i) 求 \(k\)；(ii) 求四邊形 \(OAGB\) 面積。（4 分）
before.hint: Find A from x-intercept. AG=18, AB=30, use Pythagoras for k. Split area into two triangles.
before.hintZh: 找 x 截距 A。AG=18, AB=30，畢氏定理求 k。面積分兩三角形。
before.solution:
(a) A=(18,0); Gamma:(x-18)²+y²=324.
(b)(i) AG=18 and AB=30 give k=24.
(ii) The second intersection is (576/25,-432/25). Triangle OAB has area 216. Since AB is a diameter, AGB is right with legs 18,24 and area 216, on the opposite side of AB. Total area 432.

(ii) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(B\). (3 marks)
(b) It is given that the coordinates of the point \(H\) are \((-9,8)\).
(i) Does \(\Gamma\) pass through \(H\)? Explain your answer.
(ii) \(K\) is a point lying on \(\Gamma\) such that \(ABHK\) is a quadrilateral. Someone claims that the area of \(ABHK\) cannot exceed \(70\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer. (5 marks)
before.stemZh:
13. \(A=(5,10)\)、\(B=(-1,2)\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(BP=AB\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a)(i) 求軌跡方程；(ii) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(B\) 的關係。（3 分）
(b) \(H=(-9,8)\)。
(i) 軌跡是否經過 \(H\)？解釋。
(ii) \(K\) 在軌跡上，且 \(ABHK\) 為四邊形。有人聲稱其面積不會超過 \(70\)。聲稱是否正確？解釋。（5 分）
before.hint: Circle centred at B radius 10. AH length known. Max height = centre-to-AH distance + radius. Compare with claimed value.
before.hintZh: 以 B 為心半徑 10。AH 長已知。最大高 = 中心到 AH 距離加半徑。
before.solution:
(a) The locus is the circle centred at B with radius 10.
(b)(i) BH squared=100, so H lies on it.
(ii) AH=10sqrt2 and the centre's distance from AH is 5sqrt2. Put K on the opposite side of AH from B, at maximum height 10+5sqrt2. The maximum convex-quadrilateral area is 50+(10sqrt2)(10+5sqrt2)/2=100+50sqrt2, about 170.71. Disagree; the source omitted part of the area.
before.solutionZh:
(a) Γ 是以 B 為圓心、半徑 10 的圓。

(b)(i) \(BH²=100\)，H 在圓上。

(b)(ii) \(AH=10√2\)，圓心到 AH 距離 \(5√2\)。K 在 B 另一側最遠高 \(=\) \(10+5√2\)：

\[
\max=50+\frac12(10\sqrt2)(10+5\sqrt2)=100+50\sqrt2\approx170.71
\]

不同意。

(b) The straight line \(L: y=x+k\) is tangent to \(\Gamma\). Find the values of \(k\).

\(O\) 為原點，\(A=(3,0)\)。\(P\) 滿足 \(PO:PA=1:2\)。
(a) 求軌跡 \(\Gamma\) 並作幾何描述。
(b) \(y=x+k\) 與 \(\Gamma\) 相切。求 \(k\)。

before.hint: Square the ratio, rearrange into circle. Distance from line to centre = radius for tangent.
before.hintZh: 平方比例，化成圓。中心到線距離 = 半徑即相切。

The coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-2,0)\) and \((1,0)\) respectively. \(P\) is a moving point such that \(PA=2PB\).
(a) Find the equation of the locus \(\Gamma\) of \(P\).
(b) A straight line \(L\) passes through \(A\) with slope \(k\). Find the range of values of \(k\) such that \(L\) intersects \(\Gamma\) at two distinct points.
before.stemZh:
\(A=(-2,0),B=(1,0)\)，\(P\) 滿足 \(PA=2PB\)。
(a) 求軌跡 \(\Gamma\)。
(b) \(L\) 經過 \(A\)，斜率為 \(k\)。求 \(L\) 與 \(\Gamma\) 交於不同兩點時 \(k\) 的範圍。
before.hint: Square the ratio. For two intersections, centre-to-line distance < radius.
before.hintZh: 平方比例。兩交點需中心到線距離 < 半徑。

(a) \((x+2)^2+y^2=4((x-1)^2+y^2)\) gives \((x-2)^2+y^2=4\).
(b) \(L:kx-y+2k=0\). The distance from centre \((2,0)\) is \(4|k|/\sqrt{k^2+1}\). For two intersections it must be less than \(2\), giving \(k^2<1/3\), or \(-1/\sqrt3<k<1/\sqrt3\).

Circle \(C_1\) has equation \((x-3)^2+(y-1)^2=25\) with centre \(G\). \(P\) is a moving point such that the length of the tangent drawn from \(P\) to \(C_1\) equals \(\dfrac{PG}{\sqrt{2}}\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) Describe the relationship between \(C_1\) and \(\Gamma\).
(c) Find the equations of the two horizontal tangent lines to \(\Gamma\).
(d) Explain why neither horizontal tangent to \(\Gamma\) intersects \(C_1\).
before.stemZh:
\(C_1:(x-3)^2+(y-1)^2=25\)，圓心為 \(G\)。從 \(P\) 向圓作切線的長度等於 \(PG/\sqrt2\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\)。
(b) 描述 \(C_1,\Gamma\) 的關係。
(c) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的兩條水平切線。
(d) 解釋為何這兩線均不與 \(C_1\) 相交。
before.hint: Tangent length² = d² - r². Set equal to d²/2. Then check concentric circles.
before.hintZh: 切線長² = d² - r²。等於 d²/2。同心圓判斷位置。
before.solution:
(a) Let \(d=PG\). Tangent length squared is \(d^2-25=d^2/2\), hence \(d^2=50\). Thus \(\Gamma:(x-3)^2+(y-1)^2=50\); \(d>5\), so the tangent exists.
(b) The circles are concentric, with \(C_1\) strictly inside \(\Gamma\).
(c) \(y=1\pm5\sqrt2\).
(d) Both are \(5\sqrt2>5\) from \(G\), greater than the radius of \(C_1\), so neither intersects it.

(a) (i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(A B\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) It is given that the equation of a circle \(C\) is \(x^{2}+y^{2}-18 x-9 y=0\). Someone claims that \(\Gamma\) divides \(C\) into two equal halves. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
before.stemZh:
10. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((5,8)\) 和 \((11,4)\)。動點 \(P\) 與 \(A\)、\(B\) 等距，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(a) (i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(b) 已知圓 \(C\) 的方程為 \(x^2+y^2-18x-9y=0\)。有人聲稱 \(\Gamma\) 把 \(C\) 分成兩個相等部分。判斷聲稱是否正確並解釋。
before.hint: Line bisects circle area only if through centre. Substitute centre into Γ.
before.hintZh: 直線平分圓面積必過圓心。代入中心。
before.solution:
(a)(i) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(AB\).
(ii) Put \(P=(x,y)\). Equating the squared distances gives

\[
(x-5)^2+(y-8)^2=(x-11)^2+(y-4)^2.
\]

Simplifying gives \(12x-8y-48=0\), hence \(\Gamma:3x-2y-12=0\).
(b) The circle stated in the question has centre \((9,\frac92)\). Substitution gives

\[
3(9)-2\left(\frac92\right)-12=6\ne0.
\]

The centre does not lie on \(\Gamma\). A line bisects the area of a circle only when it passes through its centre. Therefore the claim is incorrect.

14. The circle \(C\) passes through the point \(A(-2,8)\), and the centre of \(C\) is the point \(G(3,-4)\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) It is given that the equation of the straight line \(L_1\) is
\[
17x+7y+5=0.
\]Another straight line \(L_2\) is parallel to \(L_1\). It is given that \(L_2\) cuts \(C\) at two distinct points \(Q\) and \(R\). \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(QP=RP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(QR\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(iii) Suppose that \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at \(S\) and \(T\). Find the ratio of the area of \(\triangle SQT\) to the area of \(\triangle SRT\).
(8 marks)
before.stemZh:
14. 圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A(-2,8)\)，圓心為 \(G(3,-4)\)。
(a) 求 \(C\) 的方程。
(b) 直線 \(L_1\) 的方程為 \(17x+7y+5=0\)。另一條直線 \(L_2\) 與 \(L_1\) 平行，並與 \(C\) 交於兩個不同點 \(Q,R\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(QP=RP\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與線段 \(QR\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(iii) 若 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(S,T\)，求 \(\triangle SQT\) 與 \(\triangle SRT\) 的面積比。（8 分）
before.hint: Chord perpendicular bisector passes through centre. Parallel chord → perpendicular bisector perpendicular to chord.
before.hintZh: 弦垂直平分線過圓心。平行弦 → 平分線垂直弦。
before.solution:
(a) \(AG^2=(-2-3)^2+(8+4)^2=169\), so \(C:(x-3)^2+(y+4)^2=169\).

(b)(i) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(QR\).

(ii) The chord is parallel to \(L_1\), with slope \(-\frac{17}{7}\). Thus \(\Gamma\) has slope \(\frac7{17}\) and passes through the centre \(G\). Hence \(y+4=\frac7{17}(x-3)\), or \(7x-17y-89=0\).

(iii) \(Q,R\) are reflections in \(\Gamma\), which contains \(ST\). The triangles have the same base \(ST\) and equal heights. Their area ratio is \(1:1\).

13. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-7,26)\) and \((-7,-14)\) respectively. The circle \(C\) passes through \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). It is given that \(G\) lies in quadrant I and the radius of \(C\) is \(25\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) Let \(L\) be the straight line passing through \(G\) and the origin \(O\). \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(L\) is \(k\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). It is given that \(\Gamma\) passes through the point \((0,-25)\).
(i) Find \(k\).
(ii) \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at \(S,T,U\) and \(V\). Find the area of the quadrilateral formed by \(S,T,U\) and \(V\).
(8 marks)
before.stemZh:
13. \(A(-7,26)\) 和 \(B(-7,-14)\) 為一個半徑為 \(25\) 的圓上的兩點，圓心位於第一象限。
(a) 求該圓的方程。
(b) 直線 \(L\) 經過 \(G\) 及原點。動點 \(P\) 到 \(L\) 的距離為 \(k\)。軌跡 \(\Gamma\) 經過 \((0,-25)\)，求 \(k\) 及 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(c) \(\Gamma\) 與該圓相交於 \(S,T,U,V\)。求四邊形 \(STUV\) 的面積。
before.hint: A,B same x → bisector horizontal. Parallel chords cut by circle form rectangle.
before.hintZh: A,B 同 x → 平分線水平。平行弦成矩形。
before.solution:
13.

(a) Since \(A\) and \(B\) have the same \(x\)-coordinate, the \(y\)-coordinate of \(G\) is

\[
\frac{26+(-14)}2=6.
\]

Let \(G=(g,6)\). Since the radius is \(25\),

\[
(g+7)^2+(6-26)^2=25^2.
\]

Thus

\[
(g+7)^2=225,
\]

so

\[
g=8\quad \text{or}\quad g=-22.
\]

Since \(G\) lies in quadrant I,

\[
G=(8,6).
\]

Therefore, the equation of \(C\) is

\[
(x-8)^2+(y-6)^2=625.
\]

(b)(i) The equation of \(L\), which passes through \(O\) and \(G(8,6)\), is

\[
3x-4y=0.
\]

The distance from \((0,-25)\) to \(L\) is

\[
\frac{|3(0)-4(-25)|}{\sqrt{3^2+(-4)^2}}=\frac{100}{5}=20.
\]

Therefore,

\[
k=20.
\]

(b)(ii) The locus \(\Gamma\) consists of the two lines parallel to \(L\) at distance \(20\):

\[
3x-4y=100,\qquad 3x-4y=-100.
\]

The distance from \(G(8,6)\) to each of these lines is \(20\). Hence each chord cut from circle \(C\) has length

\[
2\sqrt{25^2-20^2}=30.
\]

The distance between the two parallel lines is

\[
\frac{200}{\sqrt{3^2+(-4)^2}}=40.
\]

Thus the quadrilateral formed by \(S,T,U,V\) is a rectangle with area

\[
30(40)=1200.
\]

14. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-5,-6)\) and \((1,12)\) respectively. The circle \(C\) passes through \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). It is given that the \(y\)-coordinate of \(G\) is \(2\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) The straight line \(\ell\) passes through \(A\) and \(G\). Another straight line \(L\) passes through \(B\) and is parallel to \(\ell\). Let \(P\) be a moving point on the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(L\) is equal to the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(\ell\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(L\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(iii) Let \(Q\) and \(R\) be the points of intersection of \(\Gamma\) and \(C\), where the \(y\)-coordinate of \(Q\) is greater than that of \(R\). Find \(\angle BQA\).
(9 marks)
before.stemZh:
14. 圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A=(-5,-6)\)、\(B=(1,12)\)，圓心 \(G\) 的 \(y\) 坐標為 \(2\)。
(a) 求圓方程。
(b) 直線 \(\ell\) 經過 \(A,G\)；直線 \(L\) 經過 \(B\) 且平行於 \(\ell\)。動點 \(P\) 到 \(L,\ell\) 的垂直距離相等，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(L\) 的關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。
(iii) \(\Gamma\) 與圓交於 \(Q,R\)，其中 \(Q\) 的 \(y\) 坐標較大。求 \(\angle BQA\)。（9 分）
before.hint: Equal radii. Middle parallel line. Cosine rule for central angle.
before.hintZh: 等半徑。中間平行線。餘弦定理求圓心角。
before.solution:
(a) Equal radii give g=1 and radius 10; the circle is (x-1)²+(y-2)²=100.
(b)(i) Gamma is parallel to L.
(ii) The lines have normalized constants 2 and 32, so the midline is 4x-3y+17=0.
(iii) AB squared=360 gives cos(AGB)=-4/5. The higher intersection Q lies on the major arc AB, so BQA is half the minor central angle, 71.565 degrees.

(b) The equation of a circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2+(6k+18)x-(4k+2)y+85-12k=0,
\]where \(k\) is a constant. It is known that \(\Gamma\) divides \(C\) into two equal parts.
(i) Find the centre \(G\) of the circle \(C\).
(ii) Prove that the circle touches the \(y\)-axis at a point \(D\).
(iii) Find the area of the quadrilateral \(ABGD\). (6 marks)
before.stemZh:
14. \(A=(0,-8)\)、\(B=(12,0)\)。動點 \(P\) 與 \(A,B\) 等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。（2 分）
(b) 圓 \(C:x^2+y^2+(6k+18)x-(4k+2)y+85-12k=0\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。\(\Gamma\) 把圓分成兩個相等部分。
(i) 求圓心 \(G\)；(ii) 證明圓與 \(y\) 軸相切於 \(D\)；(iii) 求四邊形 \(ABGD\) 面積。（6 分）
before.hint: Centre on Γ. Radius = distance to y-axis → tangent. Trapezium area.
before.hintZh: 中心在 Γ 上。半徑 = 到 y 軸距離 → 相切。梯形面積。
before.solution:
(a) Gamma:3x+2y-10=0.
(b)(i) Substitution of the centre (-3k-9,2k+1) gives k=-7 and G=(12,-13).
(ii) The circle is (x-12)²+(y+13)²=144; its radius equals the distance to the y-axis. D=(0,-13).
(iii) The trapezium has parallel sides AD=5,BG=13 and width 12; area 108.

(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma_1\) and \(AB\). (ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma_1\). (ii) Someone claims that there are no points of intersection between \(C\) and \(\Gamma_2\) for all real values of \(k\). Do you agree? Explain. (10 marks)
before.stemZh:
14. \(A=(5,-1)\)、\(B=(-3,5)\)。
(a) 動點 \(P_1\) 滿足 \(AP_1=BP_1\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma_1\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma_1\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求 \(\Gamma_1\) 方程。
(b) 動點 \(P_2\) 滿足 \(AP_2\perp BP_2\)，求其軌跡 \(\Gamma_2\) 方程。
(c) 圓 \(C:x^2+y^2+(4k-14)x-(3k+20)y+124=0\)。
(i) 求使圓心在 \(\Gamma_1\) 上的 \(k\)。
(ii) 有人聲稱所有實數 \(k\) 均令 \(C\) 與 \(\Gamma_2\) 沒有交點。你是否同意？解釋。（10 分）
before.hint: Thales theorem: right angle → circle on diameter. Counterexample for universal claim.
before.hintZh: 泰勒斯定理：直角 → 直徑圓。反例推翻。
before.solution:
(a) The bisector is 4x-3y+2=0 through midpoint (1,2).
(b) The diameter circle is (x-1)²+(y-2)²=25, excluding A,B.
(c)(i) Centre substitution gives k=0.
(ii) At k=0 the other centre is (7,10), radius 5. Centre separation 10 gives external tangency at (4,6), which is not excluded. This counterexample disproves the universal claim.

14. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-1,-1)\) and \((5,7)\) respectively.
(a) Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(AP=BP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(AB\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(iii) Suppose that \(G\) is a point lying on \(\Gamma\). Denote the \(x\)-coordinate of \(G\) by \(h\). Let \(C\) be the circle which is centred at \(G\) and passes through \(A\) and \(B\). Prove that the equation of \(C\) is
\[
2x^2+2y^2-4hx+(3h-18)y-h-22=0.
\](6 marks)
(b) The coordinates of the point \(D\) are \((-23,21)\). Using (a)(iii), find the area of the circle which passes through \(A\), \(B\) and \(D\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)
before.stemZh:
14. \(A=(-1,-1)\)、\(B=(5,7)\)。
(a) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=BP\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程；
(iii) 圓心 \(G\) 在 \(\Gamma\) 上，其 \(x\) 坐標為 \(h\)。以 \(G\) 為圓心的圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A,B\)。證明其方程為 \(2x^2+2y^2-4hx+(3h-18)y-h-22=0\)。（6 分）
(b) \(D=(-23,21)\)。利用 (a)(iii)，求經過 \(A,B,D\) 的圓面積，以 \(\pi\) 表示。（3 分）
before.hint: Perpendicular bisector. Substitute D to find h. Area = πr².
before.hintZh: 垂直平分線。代入 D 求 h。面積 = πr²。
before.solution:
(a) The perpendicular bisector is 3x+4y-18=0. Thus G=(h,(18-3h)/4). Expanding the circle with squared radius GA squared gives the requested equation.
(b) Substituting D gives 154h+1540=0, so G=(-10,12). Radius squared=250 and area=250π.

(b) 直線 \(L_1,L_2\) 相交於 \(A\)。動點 \(P\) 與兩直線等距，其軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma,L_1,L_2\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) \(L_1\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(A,D\)，且 \(AD=12\)；\(L_2\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(A,E\)。\(L_1\) 的斜率為正，且 \(L_2:y=3\)。有人聲稱 \(B\) 在 \(\Gamma\) 上。你是否同意？解釋答案。（6 分）
before.hint: Angle bisectors are equidistant from two lines. Substitute D into circle.
before.hintZh: 角平分線 = 到兩線等距。代入 D 入圓。
before.solution:

(ii) Let the positive slope be \(m\) and put \(D=A+t(1,m)\). Substitution into the circle gives the nonzero root \(t=(12+6m)/(1+m^2)\). Hence

AD=\frac{12+6m}{\sqrt{1+m^2}}=12.

(ii) the maximum area of \(\triangle A B P\),

(b) 以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。設 \(C\) 為 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的交點。若 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((3,5)\) 和 \((11,5)\)，求：
(i) \(\Gamma\) 的方程；
(ii) \(\triangle ABP\) 的最大面積；
(iii) 當 \(\angle APB=90^\circ\) 時，由 \(\Gamma\)、\(BC\) 及 \(BP\) 所包圍區域的面積。

& (x-11)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}=16
\end{aligned}
\]

(ii) & 
Area of \(\triangle A B P\) is maximum when \(A B \perp B P\). 
Required area

\[
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{1}{2} A B \cdot B P \\
& =\frac{1}{2}(11-3)(4) \\
& =16
\end{aligned}
\]

(iii) & The region is a sector.

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \begin{aligned}
\angle A B P & =\cos ^{-1} \frac{B P}{A B} \\
& =\cos ^{-1} \frac{4}{8} \\
& =60^{\circ}
\end{aligned} \\
& \text { Required area } \\
& =\pi(B P)^{2} \cdot \frac{60^{\circ}}{360^{\circ}} \\
& =\pi \cdot 4^{2} \cdot \frac{60^{\circ}}{360^{\circ}} \\
& =\frac{8 \pi}{3} \approx 8.38
\end{aligned}
\]

before.stem:
Denote the origin by \(O\).
(a) \(A\) and \(B\) are points on the positive \(x\)-axis such that the \(x\)-coordinate of \(A\) is greater than that of \(B\). A vertical line through \(B\) cuts the line \(y=mx\) at point \(C\), where \(m\) is a positive constant with \(AB=BC\). Let \(D\) be a point such that \(ABCD\) is a square. Express the slope of \(OD\) in terms of \(m\).
(b) The coordinates of \(M\) and \(N\) are \((6,5)\) and \((10,0)\) respectively. Let \(P\) and \(Q\) lie on \(OM\) and \(MN\) respectively, and let \(R\) and \(S\) lie on the \(x\)-axis. If \(PQRS\) is a square, find the \(x\)-coordinate of \(P\).
before.stemZh:
\(O\) 為原點。
(a) \(A,B\) 在正 \(x\) 軸上，\(A\) 的 \(x\) 坐標大於 \(B\)。經過 \(B\) 的垂直線與 \(y=mx\) 交於 \(C\)，其中 \(m>0\) 且 \(AB=BC\)。\(ABCD\) 為正方形。以 \(m\) 表示 \(OD\) 的斜率。
(b) \(M=(6,5),N=(10,0)\)；\(P,Q\) 分別在 \(OM,MN\) 上，\(R,S\) 在 \(x\) 軸上。若 \(PQRS\) 為正方形，求 \(P\) 的 \(x\) 坐標。
before.hint: Parameterise B. Square side = height h.
before.hintZh: 參數 B。正方形邊 = 高 h。
before.solution:
(a) Put \(B=(b,0)\). Then \(C=(b,mb),A=(b+mb,0),D=(b+mb,mb)\). Thus the slope is \(m/(m+1)\).
(b) \(OM:y=5x/6\) and \(MN:y=-5x/4+25/2\). Let the common height of \(P,Q\) be \(h\). The square side is \(h\), so \(x_Q=x_P+h\) and \(h=5x_P/6\). Substituting into \(MN\) gives \(5x_P/6=-55x_P/24+25/2\), hence \(x_P=4\).

Denote the origin by \(O\). The coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((2t,\,3t)\) and \((5t,\,5t)\) respectively, where \(t\) is a positive constant. Denote the reflection image of \(A\) with respect to \(OB\) by \(C\).
(a) Someone claims that \(OABC\) is a rhombus. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(b) If the area of \(OABC\) is \(245\), find the coordinates of \(C\).
before.hint: Rhombus: all sides equal. Area = diagonal product /2.
before.hintZh: 菱形：四邊等。面積 = 對角線積/2。
before.solution:
(a) \(OB:y=x\), so \(C=(3t,2t)\). The four sides all have length \(\sqrt{13}t\); thus it is a rhombus.
(b) Its perpendicular diagonals have lengths \(OB=5\sqrt2t\) and \(AC=\sqrt2t\). Area \(=5t^2=245\), so \(t=7\) and \(C=(21,14)\).

before.stem:
13. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((0,6)\) and \((8,0)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(A P=2 B P\).
(a) Prove that the locus is a circle.
(b) Let the centre of the locus be \(C\). Someone claims that the ratio of the area of \(\triangle Q A B\) to the area of \(\triangle Q B C\) is \(3: 1\), where \(Q(-6,0)\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
before.stemZh:
13. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((0,6)\) 和 \((8,0)\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=2BP\)。
(a) 證明 \(P\) 的軌跡為一個圓。
(b) 設該軌跡的圓心為 \(C\)。有人聲稱，當 \(Q=(-6,0)\) 時，\(\triangle QAB\) 與 \(\triangle QBC\) 的面積比為 \(3:1\)。你是否同意？解釋答案。
before.hint: Apollonius circle: square ratio. Collinearity check slopes.
before.hintZh: 阿氏圓：平方比例。斜率檢查共線。
before.solution:
13. (a) Let \(P=(x, y)\)
\(\sqrt{x^{2}+(y-6)^{2}}=2 \sqrt{(x-8)^{2}+y^{2}}\)

\(3 x^{2}+3 y^{2}-64 x+12 y+220=0\)
\(x^{2}+y^{2}-\frac{64}{3} x+4 y+\frac{220}{3}=0\)

\(\left(x-\frac{32}{3}\right)^{2}+(y+2)^{2}=\left(\frac{20}{3}\right)^{2}\)
∴ The locus is a circle with centre \(\left(\frac{32}{3},-2\right)\) and radius \(\frac{20}{3}\)
(b) \(\frac{\text { Area of } \triangle Q A B}{\text { Area of } \triangle Q B C}=\frac{\text { altitude of } \triangle Q A B}{\text { altitude of } \triangle Q B C}\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{6}{2} \\
& =\frac{3}{1}
\end{aligned}
\]

slope of \(A B=\frac{6-0}{0-8}=-\frac{3}{4}\)
Slope of \(B C=\frac{-2-6}{\frac{32}{3}-0}=-\frac{3}{4}\)
\(\therefore A, B\) and \(C\) are collinear.
\(\frac{\text { Area of } \triangle Q A B}{\text { Area of } \triangle Q B C}=\frac{A B}{B C}\)

\[
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{8-0}{\frac{32}{3}-8} / \frac{6-0}{0+2} / \frac{\sqrt{(0-8)^{2}+(6-0)^{2}}}{\sqrt{\left(\frac{32}{3}-8\right)^{2}+(-2-0)^{2}}} \\
& =\frac{3}{1}
\end{aligned}
\]

Hence, the claim is correct. I agree.

14. The coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-6,0)\) and \((12,24)\) respectively. \(P\) is a moving point on the coordinate plane such that \(AP=BP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(G\).
(a)
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(G\) and \(AB\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(G\).
(b) \(G\) cuts the \(x\)-axis at \(C\). A straight line parallel to \(AB\) cuts the \(x\)-axis and \(G\) at \(D\) and \(E\) respectively. It is given that \(E\) is above the \(x\)-axis. If the area of \(\triangle CDE\) is \(24\), find the area of the circle passing through \(C\), \(D\) and \(E\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(8 marks)
before.stemZh:
14. \(A=(-6,0)\)、\(B=(12,24)\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=BP\)，軌跡記為 \(G\)。
(a)(i) 描述 \(G\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求 \(G\) 方程。
(b) \(G\) 與 \(x\) 軸交於 \(C\)。一條平行於 \(AB\) 的直線分別與 \(x\) 軸、\(G\) 交於 \(D,E\)，且 \(E\) 在 \(x\) 軸上方。若 \([CDE]=24\)，求經過 \(C,D,E\) 的圓面積，以 \(\pi\) 表示。（8 分）
before.hint: Angle bisector. Similar triangles. Right angle circumcircle radius = half hypotenuse.
before.hintZh: 角平分線。相似三角形。直角外接圓半徑 = 斜邊一半。
before.solution:
(a) G is the bisector 3x+4y-57=0.
(b) C=(19,0), M=(3,12), area AMC=150. Similar right triangles give CD/CA=2/5, hence CD=10. As angle CED is right, the circumcircle has radius 5 and area 25π.

14. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((11,20)\) and \((-13,2)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P\) is equidistant from \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a)
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(AB\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) The circle \(C\) passes through the points \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). It is given that \(G\) lies on the straight line
\[
x-18y+49=0.
\](i) Find the equation of \(C\).
(ii) \(DE\) is a chord of the circle \(C\) such that \(AB=DE\) and \(AB\parallel DE\). Find the perimeter of the quadrilateral \(ABED\).
(8 marks)
before.stemZh:
14. \(A=(11,20)\)、\(B=(-13,2)\)。動點 \(P\) 與兩點等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a)(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求軌跡方程。
(b) 圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A,B\)，圓心 \(G\) 在 \(x-18y+49=0\) 上。
(i) 求圓方程；(ii) \(DE\) 是另一條弦，\(DE=AB\) 且 \(DE\parallel AB\)。求四邊形 \(ABED\) 周界。（8 分）
before.hint: Perpendicular bisector. Parallel chords form rectangle.
before.hintZh: 垂直平分線。平行弦成矩形。
before.solution:
(a) The perpendicular bisector is 4x+3y-29=0.
(b)(i) The centre is (5,3), squared radius 325.
(ii) The distinct equal parallel chord is the reflected chord. Chord length 30 and separation 20 form a rectangle, giving perimeter 100, with endpoints labelled in simple-polygon order.

13. Let \(P(x,y)\) be a moving point on the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P\) is equidistant from the point \((-2,-3)\) and the line
\[
L:y=-5.
\]Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(C\).
(a) Show that the equation of \(C\) is
\[
y=\frac{1}{4}x^2+x-3.
\](b) Let \(A\) and \(B\) be the points of intersection of \(C\) and the \(x\)-axis, where \(A\) lies to the right of \(B\).
(i) Find the coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\).
(ii) Let \(M\) be a point on \(L\) and \(N\) be the point of intersection of \(AM\) and \(C\). If
\[
\text{area of }\triangle BMN:\text{area of }\triangle BAN=2:3,
\]find the coordinates of \(N\).
(7 marks)
before.hint: Equate distances → parabola. x-intercepts. Collinearity ratio.
before.hintZh: 等距 → 拋物線。x 截距。共線比例。
before.solution:
(a) Squaring equal distances gives y=x²/4+x-3.
(b)(i) A=(2,0),B=(-6,0).
(ii) Collinearity gives |yN+5|/|yN|=2/3. The branches yN=-3 and -15 arise; -15 is below the parabola's minimum -4. At y=-3, x=0 or -4. Both points qualify.
